meta.what: The mutation ledger as data — one record per nursery/glyph mutation, 2026-09-28 arc. The RSI loop's memory: this file is what the proposer retrieves from.
sources: training/glyph_g1/ (g1_dataset.py, train.py incl. G4_LOSS_MASK, commit chain)

conventions.verdicts: KEEP / REPLICATED / KILL / INCONCLUSIVE / QUEUED — exactly the RESULTS.md wording, downgraded nothing.
conventions.metric_delta: val_bpb delta is mutant-minus-baseline (negative = better). Glyph lane reports accuracy points.
conventions.diagnostic_validated: Only set where the ledger itself says the KILL's diagnostic validated the underlying mechanism (G4). The scorer reads this; nothing else may.
conventions.queued: D4 and G5 are named in the D3/G4 receipts but have NOT run. They are recorded to consume their IDs honestly — the proposer proposes D5/G6, never a re-spell of the queue.
conventions.no_invented_fields: Every number traces to a receipt above. null means not measured.

mutations.mutation: Delta-attention: split the heads — second half attends on the hidden-path delta h − shift(h,1) via a second projection pass over the same c_q/c_k/c_v row-slices (zero new params, 50.3M).
mutations.diff_summary: training/delta_increment/train.py vs the receipt baseline: delta_x = x - shift(x,1); delta heads derive q/k/v from delta_x via F.linear on weight row-slices; VE gate reads the delta path; one FA3 call over all heads; rotary/norms/window/c_proj/residuals untouched.
mutations.lesson: The difference signal is real (per-token parity on 7.5% fewer tokens) but the ~9% wall-clock overhead ate the whole advantage at fixed budget — a mutation must be free, not just good.
receipts: gem-hits.md: difference-operator KILL (partial — led to D2)

mutations.mutation: Free delta: one projection pass only — delta heads' k/v are the POST-projection temporal diffs of the same row-slices (k_d[t]=k[t]−k[t−1], v_d likewise; zero-row shift at t=0), q as-is. Zero new params.
mutations.diff_summary: training/delta_free/train.py vs delta_increment/train.py: the second F.linear trio and the hidden-state shift are DELETED; kd/vd are elementwise temporal diffs of projected k/v row-slices; VE gate back on the absolute path for all heads (identical to baseline). Diff is the delta-path block only.

metric_delta.direction: better (~100x the margin D1 lost by)

mutations.lesson: D1's signal kept, D1's cost removed → the nursery's first novel-model KEEP. Per-token the difference signal is decisively real once it costs nothing.

mutations.mutation: Seed replication of D2: both arms (receipt baseline + free-delta) re-run at seed 1337, seed-only diffs, everything else identical.
mutations.diff_summary: training/delta_seed1337/{baseline,free_delta}/train.py: byte-identical to the receipt baseline and to delta_free/train.py with seed 42→1337 only (verified: diff <(sed s/1337/42/) original is empty both arms); prepare.py byte-identical copies; runs serialized, GPU-checked free before each.
mutations.lesson: Two seeds, two paired wins of ~0.029 bpb — the effect is ~6x seed noise. Free-delta is hardened; the paired-replication protocol is what earns the right to stack mutations on it.

mutations.mutation: First generative glyph-domain model: 25.3M-param free-delta GPT over V=32 renderer codes (tone idx 0-10 + edge fam×level 11-30 + SEP 31), seq 6144, next-frame prediction on 6,000 frames (5 lavfi sources + MockScene, 48×36 cells).
mutations.diff_summary: training/glyph_g1/: g1_dataset.py renders frames into the chiaroscuro code-space (data.npz, temporal 70/15/15 split per source, no shuffle); train.py is the D2 free-delta skeleton re-tokenized to V=32 (SSSL windows one-frame-short/two-frame-long).
mutations.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (majority gate cleared +19.3 pts; persistence gate failed on 2 of 3 dynamic sources)
mutations.lesson: Beats majority by +19.3 and wins on the fast-motion source, but copy-last-frame (persistence) wins on slow feeds — statics dominate overall accuracy; persistence is the bar the model must beat per-source.

mutations.mutation: Changed-cells diagnostic on the G1 replication: same config/seed, plus changed-cells-only accuracy (cell != same cell of previous frame).
mutations.diff_summary: training/glyph_g1/train.py: eval path adds the G2 changed-cell mask (cmask from prev-frame comparison) and reports model_changed_acc + changed_frac alongside overall accuracy.
mutations.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (gate replicated: majority +19.1, persistence fails life −12.2 / mandelbrot −6.4, testsrc2 +6.7)

cost.note: same config/seed as G1 — clean replication

mutations.lesson: The model learned statics + predictable dynamics, not hard dynamics: the cellular automaton (5.6%) and fractal zoom (7.5%) are NOT learned in 5 minutes — G1's INCONCLUSIVE is fully explained.

mutations.mutation: Framerate scaling 10→20fps: 2× temporal data, finer dt (G1_FPS=20 → data20.npz), same model/seed.
mutations.diff_summary: training/glyph_g1/: g1_dataset.py FPS_OVERRIDE via G1_FPS env (data20.npz); train.py unchanged except corpus path — the mutation is the corpus, not the model.
mutations.lesson: Doubling framerate made frames MORE similar and strengthened persistence's statics advantage — finer dt does not teach hard dynamics. Capacity is going to the ~95% of cells that never change.

mutations.mutation: Diff-target loss mask: train only on changed cells — statics + SEP masked from the gradient (G4_LOSS_MASK=1), with a >=100-target resample guard.
mutations.diff_summary: training/glyph_g1/train.py: self.loss_mask_mode from G4_LOSS_MASK env; per-example loss mask zeroes static cells and SEP before the gradient; eval reports both overall and changed-cell accuracy for the masked model.
mutations.verdict: KILL (by the registered overall-accuracy gate — 61.6% overall, majority-margin ~0)
mutations.lesson: The gate's KILL is the hypothesis's KEEP: predicting differences (not states) tripled-to-quadrupled dynamics learning on EVERY source. Persistence covers statics for free, so the arc derives the hybrid refiner (copy-last-frame + diff-head corrections on changed cells).
